OnlyWinget third-party licenses and notices

Each component directory identifies the package and version used to build
this distribution. The terms in those directories apply to the corresponding
components. The Windows ML directory includes the upstream third-party
notices for the native runtime used by that package, including ONNX Runtime.
Windows App SDK, Windows ML and Windows SDK redistributable files remain
subject to their respective Microsoft license terms.

The NSIS setup also installs its own license, notice and corresponding
NSIS source archive in ThirdPartyNotices/NSIS.
